verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LM Studio serves local models over OpenAI-like endpoints and a REST API with completions and chat completions. Nothing in the pack documents token streaming, such as server-sent events or a stream option. An OpenAI-like API suggests streaming might be available, but implied compatibility is not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream generated tokens back to my application as they are produced
